headline: Judge tosses publishers' antitrust suits over Google AI Overviews
body: A quiet day. Judge Amit Mehta dismissed antitrust suits from Chegg and Penske Media over Google's AI Overviews, ruling that 'an expectation is not an agreement'. Leaving a dominant player unchallenged is a small rise in Power Concentration, lifting Enslaved God. Apple tightened macOS Full Disk Access over AI-agent privacy risks, a small check on surveillance. Horizon Balance edged up to -7.74.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Libertarian Utopia -0.08, from the Google ruling (-0.11), partly offset by fading earlier news (+0.03); Conquerors -0.08, from fading earlier news (-0.08).
